description: Figure 3 is a pie chart illustrating the domain distribution of the annotated AttrEval-GenSearch test set, which comprises 12 distinct domains. The chart is divided into 12 colored slices, each labeled with its corresponding domain name and percentage share. The largest segment, colored blue, represents “AI/NLP Research” at 24.3%. Other notable segments include “Daily Life” (7.1%, light teal), “Pet & Animal” (5.5%, orange), “Med & Health” (6.7%, green), “History” (8.2%, yellow), “Law” (5.1%, red), “Science” (6.7%, light blue), “Econ. & Fin.” (18.4%, dark teal), “Business” (5.9%, dark red), “Geography” (2.7%, light green), “Math” (1.2%, dark green), and “Game&Anime” (8.2%, orange). Each slice is clearly labeled with its domain and percentage value, and the chart includes a legend that maps the colors to the domain names. The segments appear to be arranged in a clockwise descending order by size, starting from the largest segment at the top right.
